capabilities: Edit .excalidraw drawings in the embedded official Excalidraw editor
Save drawings as plain Excalidraw JSON, written only when content changes
Link shapes to notes, websites and other shapes
Export drawings as PNG, SVG or to the clipboard
Apply changes made on disk by sync, git or other tabs to open drawings
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.15+. Editing is desktop-only; phones and tablets get read-only view. The drawing library is not persisted across sessions. Only one plugin can own .excalidraw files at a time, so it conflicts with the Excalidraw and Just Simple Excalidraw plugins. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Excalidraw's web embeds, AI tools and Mermaid import are deliberately excluded.
intentEvidence: What would make you switch from the Excalidraw plugin you use now, or from excalidraw.com?
problem: Obsidian has no built-in drawing editor, and existing Excalidraw plugins store drawings in custom or compressed Markdown formats, need network access, or lack offline privacy.

relations.evidence: What would make you switch from the Excalidraw plugin you use now, or from excalidraw.com?
The official @excalidraw/excalidraw 0.18.1: its drawing tools, the hand-drawn fonts, frames
An agent skill teaches Claude, or another agent, to write drawings that open here

summary: Drawing editor that opens .excalidraw files in the official Excalidraw editor inside Obsidian, keeping each drawing as plain Excalidraw JSON written only on change.
